# ABOUT COMMENTS

#           A comment starts with #
#   PART 2: the page text, below the second ---
#           A comment is wrapped like this: <!-- your comment -->

# Change it to anything, e.g. "CV", "Resume", "Experience".
# The menu label is separate: edit it in _quarto.yml.
title: "Curriculum Vitae"

# This line makes sure your PDF gets published with your site.
# Leave it as is.
resources:
  - cv.pdf
---

  ADD YOUR CV
  Right now this page shows a placeholder PDF.

  3. Click "Add file" > "Upload files" and drag in cv.pdf.
     It replaces the placeholder automatically.
  4. Commit. Your new CV shows up in 1 to 2 minutes.

  Updating your CV later? Repeat the same steps.
